title: 第一卷 第7章 炼气三层净元之体第一卷 第8章 看人下菜碟好大的胆子
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 一炷香后。
掌生阁后院，一处静谧奢华的密室。
门被推开。
换上了一身轻薄纱裙的九灵走了进来。
曹阳坐在桌旁，抬眼望去，呼吸顿时停滞了半拍。
洗净了脸上的黑灰，九灵露出了真正的容颜。
琼鼻樱唇，肌肤胜雪，眼角那一点泪痣更添了几分楚楚可怜。
甚至，连脸上的凤凰印记，此时看起来都有种别样感觉。
破烂衣衫换成了合体的纱裙，那盈盈一握的纤腰和傲人的曲线展露无遗，整个人透着一股难以言喻的风情。
九灵反手关上门，忐忑地抬起头，偷偷打量着眼前这个买下自己的男人。
男人裹在黑袍里，看不清面容，也看不清他的底细。
可不知道为何，当视线落在他身上时，体内原本死寂的血液竟莫名生出一种沸腾感。
这个男人，给她一种深不可测的危险气息。
曹阳同样在看着她。
两人的视线在半空中交汇。
就在这一刻，曹阳脑海中的阴阳造化鼎剧烈震颤起来，前所未有的轰鸣声在神魂中炸响。
极品！
真正的绝世极品！
曹阳忽然笑了。
这三千五百块灵石的饥荒，背得太值了。
“过来。”
他拍了拍身旁的床榻。
九灵站在门边，好像听不到一般。
对于被买走当炉鼎的女修来说，接下来的命运极其明确。
被无情地榨干气血，抽空修为，最后成为一具干瘪的尸体。
认命是一回事。
面对死亡的恐惧是另一回事。
曹阳站起身，走到九灵面前，轻声开口，“双修并非采补，你无需担心。”
说完，也不等九灵有所反应，攥住她的手腕，轻轻一扯。
九灵惊呼一声，跌入曹阳怀里。
纱裙本就轻薄，瞬间滑落大半，大片雪白的肌肤直接暴露在空气中。
触碰的瞬间，曹阳灵魂上传来的颤动越发剧烈。
他也不再犹豫，一把将九灵拦腰抱起，转身放在柔软的床榻上。
双掌直接贴上九灵的后背，体内的引气诀功法毫无保留地全速运转。
九灵绝望地闭上眼睛，眼角滑落两行清泪。
她放弃了抵抗，等待着那种生不如死的抽取感降临。
可预想中的剧痛并没有出现。
相反，一股极为浑厚的暖流涌入她的体内。
content_en:
After a stick of incense.
The backyard of Zhangsheng Pavilion is a quiet and luxurious secret room.
The door was pushed open.
Jiuling, who had changed into a light gauze skirt, walked in.
Cao Yang sat at the table, looked up, and his breathing suddenly stopped for half a beat.
After washing away the black dust on his face, Jiuling revealed his true appearance.
Her nose and lips are beautiful, her skin is as good as snow, and the mole at the corner of her eye makes her look even more pitiful.
Even the phoenix mark on his face looked different at this time.
The tattered clothes were replaced by a fitted gauze skirt. Her slender waist and proud curves were fully exposed, and her whole person exuded an indescribable aura.
Jiuling closed the door with her backhand, raised her head anxiously, and secretly looked at the man who bought her in front of her.
The man was wrapped in a black robe, and his face and details could not be seen clearly.
But for some reason, when his eyes fell on him, the dead blood in his body felt inexplicably boiling.
This man gave her an aura of unfathomable danger.
Cao Yang was also looking at her.
Their eyes met in mid-air.
At this moment, the Yin-Yang Creation Cauldron in Cao Yang's mind trembled violently, and an unprecedented roar exploded in his soul.
Excellent!
A true masterpiece!
Cao Yang suddenly smiled.
The famine of these 3,500 spiritual stones is so worth it.
"Come here."
He patted the bed next to him.
Jiuling stood by the door, as if he couldn't hear it.
For the female cultivator who was bought to be used as a cauldron, her next fate was extremely clear.
He was ruthlessly drained of energy and blood, took away time to cultivate, and finally became a shriveled corpse.
Accepting your fate is one thing.
It's another thing to face the fear of death.
Cao Yang stood up, walked to Jiuling, and said softly, "Double cultivation is not a supplement, you don't need to worry."
After saying that, without waiting for Jiuling to react, he grabbed her wrist and pulled it gently.
Jiuling exclaimed and fell into Cao Yang's arms.
The gauze skirt was already thin, and most of it slipped off in an instant, leaving a large area of ​​snow-white skin directly exposed to the air.
At the moment of contact, the tremor in Cao Yang's soul became more intense.
He no longer hesitated, picked up Jiuling by the waist, turned around and placed her on the soft bed.
Both palms were placed directly on Jiuling's back, and the Qi-Entraining Technique in his body was running at full speed without any reservation.
Jiuling closed her eyes in despair, and two lines of clear tears fell from the corners of her eyes.
She gave up her resistance and waited for the feeling of extraction that was worse than death.
The expected severe pain did not appear.
On the contrary, an extremely strong warmth flowed into her body.
